summary: A responsive storefront built for secure checkout and search visibility from launch.
challenge: A skincare brand needed an online store that felt as considered as the products, worked on any device, and could be found in search.
approach: Built the storefront around a responsive UI and a secure checkout, then tested both across devices before launch.
Set the technical SEO foundations at build time rather than retrofitting them once traffic mattered.
metaTitle: Case Study: Los Angeles skincare brand | TDM
metaDescription: A responsive storefront built for secure checkout and search visibility from launch.
